natural_body: Deep discounts spike signups +31% but risk renewal. Use tactically with guardrails.

first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, and two inherited findings indicate that reducing onboarding friction improved completion, time-to-value, and durable SMB activation. This aligns more directly with sustainable qualified revenue than discounting, which carries renewal risk. Verification should confirm applicability and experiment quality before commitment.
